item.title: 25 Million Across UK Living Below Minimum Income Standard, Report Finds
item.description: A new report reveals 25 million people across the UK are living below the Minimum Income Standard, including more than half of all children. The findings have sparked renewed political debate over living standards and the cost of living crisis.The post 25 Million Across UK Living Below Minimum Income Standard, Report Finds appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Former SNP MSP to Stand for Alba on Highlands and Islands List
item.description: Former SNP MSP Mike MacKenzie will stand for ALBA on the Highlands and Islands list in May’s Holyrood election, joining Angus Brendan MacNeil and other candidates in a bid to win regional representation.The post Former SNP MSP to Stand for Alba on Highlands and Islands List appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Contemporary Lodge Set Above Loch Ness
item.description: Set within the Loch Ness Highland Resort on Glendoe Road, this contemporary two bedroom lodge with wrap around decking and hot tub offers year round leisure use and sub letting potential in one of Scotland’s most iconic landscapes.The post A Contemporary Lodge Set Above Loch Ness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney Marine Plan Sets New Course for Island Seas
item.description: Orkney’s new Regional Marine Plan sets out how fish farming, renewables and conservation will be managed up to 12 nautical miles offshore, aiming to protect island waters while supporting sustainable economic growth and local communities.The post Orkney Marine Plan Sets New Course for Island Seas appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £300,000 Fund Backs 32 Community Projects Across Scotland
item.description: Thirty-two community projects across Scotland have shared £300,000 in funding through a Scottish Government and STV Children’s Appeal partnership, supporting grassroots groups tackling poverty, isolation and inequality at local level.The post £300,000 Fund Backs 32 Community Projects Across Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New National Low Vision Service to Bring Specialist Care Closer to Home
item.description: Scotland is launching a new Community Low Vision Service, backed by £144 million investment in optometry, allowing patients with visual impairment to receive specialist care closer to home instead of attending hospital clinics.The post New National Low Vision Service to Bring Specialist Care Closer to Home appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Angus MacDonald Condemns Renewable Community Benefit Proposals as ‘A Betrayal of Rural Scotland’
item.description: Angus MacDonald has criticised Scottish Government proposals on renewable community benefit payments, arguing Highland and Island communities are being short-changed as multi-billion pound energy developments expand across rural Scotland.The post Angus MacDonald Condemns Renewable Community Benefit Proposals as ‘A Betrayal of Rural Scotland’ appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ariane Burgess Backs Moray Firth Communities Over Offshore Wind Concerns
item.description: Ariane Burgess has raised Moray Firth community concerns in the Scottish Parliament over the Moray FLOW-Park offshore wind proposal, calling for stronger local involvement and scrutiny of public funding and marine impacts.The post Ariane Burgess Backs Moray Firth Communities Over Offshore Wind Concerns appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Beinn Dearg Habitats Recover After Years of Deer Management in North Ross
item.description: Mountain habitats at Beinn Dearg near Ullapool are improving after long-term deer management efforts in North Ross, with reduced grazing and trampling recorded across protected blanket bog and grassland areas.The post Beinn Dearg Habitats Recover After Years of Deer Management in North Ross appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Nesting Boxes Installed in Glen Prosen to Support Declining Bird Species
item.description: Forestry and Land Scotland has installed nesting boxes for kestrels, barn owls and dippers in Glen Prosen as part of a Nature Restoration Fund project supporting habitat recovery in the Angus Glens.The post Nesting Boxes Installed in Glen Prosen to Support Declining Bird Species appeared first on The Highland Times.
